text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Would you like to race against me?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I would be more than happy to, 
please.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I was speaking with Meek just a moment 
ago.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Since we had such a great joint training 
session, I thought it'd be good motivation 
for both of us if we kept the momentum 
going and had a little competition.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Please... cheer me on. ...Mun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since they said any event was fine, I 
decided to choose it myself.
choice_data_list: I'll win it with sheer speed!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Speed. ...I will become the wind. 
...Whoosh.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Stamina. ...I will run lots and lots. 
Yay.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Power. ...Muscles fully pumped, going 
at full blast.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...A test of guts. ...I can do it. 
...Because I have Trainer cheering me on.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...A battle of wits. ...I will show you my 
brainpower.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...A battle of endurance. ...It's okay, 
I'm confident.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...A loss. Hmph.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek did a fantastic job out there. We 
gathered valuable data, too... Let's give 
it our all again tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much for the match! Let's 
definitely do this again next time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> looks thoroughly satisfied with the 
victory. I'm already looking forward to 
our next showdown!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...M-Mmmhh~... ...I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek...! No, it was my own shortcoming! 
Next time, without fail...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for the match...! 
Please, let us do this again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Happy Meek and Trainer Kiryuin walked 
away, it looked as though... a burning 
flame had ignited in their eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> looks pleased with her winning streak. I 
want to train her even harder for the next 
race!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...I won. We did it. ...Thank you, 
Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
No, it's all thanks to Meek's hard work. 
...Shall we stop by the bakery on our way 
home today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Happy Meek was so strong...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: <chrname> slumped her shoulders in defeat.
